title: PrestaShop Store Build
meta: A new PrestaShop store with catalog, payment modules, carriers and core pages, ready for orders. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: PrestaShop store development, ready for its first order
overview: We install and configure a PrestaShop store on hosting you own, or set up the one you already have. We choose a theme with you, apply your logo and colors, add your products with images and combinations, connect a payment module, set up carriers, zones and taxes, and write the standard pages. You get a private preview link, a launch checklist and handover notes that explain the back office in everyday words.

faq: On hosting that you own. If you have none, we suggest options that run PrestaShop well, and you buy the plan. Hosting is billed by the host, not by us.
Which PrestaShop version do you install?
The current stable release, unless you need an older one for a module you already use. We tell you the version we installed in the handover notes.
Can you use a theme I already bought?
Yes. Send us the theme file and licence details and we install and set it up. If you have none, we suggest a few that suit your products.
Do you set up VAT and EU rules?
We set up tax rules and zones as you describe them. Tax law varies, so please confirm the rates with your accountant, and we apply what you tell us.
